setup_tools.withAnEmptyShopRewardPoints: With an empty shop, reward points cannot be used for anything. Declare a few items before turning on the rewards module.
setup_tools.withAPoolOf0Nothing: With a pool of 0, nothing can be allocated. If the company has not been given a budget, contact the system administrator.
setup_tools.withinTheBudgetNoApprovalNeeded: 🤝 Within the budget, no approval needed
setup_tools.withoutADefaultSetUnassignedCycles: Without a default set, unassigned cycles cannot open scoring forms — employees' conduct screen is empty.
setup_tools.withoutAnOpenPeriodNobodyCan: 🚦 Without an open period nobody can submit
setup_tools.withoutAnyTemplateThePrintScreen: Without any template, the print screen still offers six designs. Templates here are your company's own versions — with a fixed logo, signature and wording.
setup_tools.withoutGrantingBudgetsToAnyoneEvery: Without granting budgets to anyone, every point award lands in your approval queue.
